title: Telescope of K-projective stages is K-projective
statement: An exhaustive split filtered union of K-projective finite stages is K-projective.

proof_origin.place: 2026-10-21 (J9): reuse the already proved upstream theorem with the identical signature and the same finite-stage and telescope proof dependencies; retire the redundant Sheaf copy. No mathematical dependency is pruned.

lean.statement:
theorem isKProjective_of_filtered_free_telescope
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ)
    (F : ℕ → CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} A) ℤ)
    (ι : ∀ n, F n ⟶ P) (step : ∀ n, F n ⟶ F (n + 1))
    (hzero : IsZero (F 0)) (hmono : ∀ n, Mono (ι n))
    (hcompat : ∀ n, step n ≫ ι (n + 1) = ι n)
    (hexhaustive : ∀ (k : ℤ) (x : P.X k),
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (y : (F n).X k), (ι n).f k y = x)
    (hsplit : ∀ (n : ℕ) (k : ℤ),
      ∃ r : (F (n + 1)).X k ⟶ (F n).X k,
        (step n).f k ≫ r = 𝟙 ((F n).X k))
    (hstage : ∀ n, (F n).IsKProjective) :
    P.IsKProjective
